heading: Paying for your session
intro: Payment is due before your session. Any of the three below is fine — use whichever you already have. Please include your name in the note so I can match it to your appointment.

methods.name: Venmo
methods.note: Opens Venmo straight to Julienne's account. Please put your name in the payment note.

methods.name: PayPal
methods.note: Opens PayPal with the details filled in. If you are able, send as 'Friends and Family'.

methods.name: Zelle
methods.note: Zelle works inside your own bank's app — search for that email address to send.

footnote: Every one of these should show Julienne Blackburn as the recipient before you confirm. If you see any other name, stop and get in touch — it is worth the extra ten seconds to check. And if cost is the only thing standing between you and getting help, say so on the contact page. We will work something out.
supportBody: The prayers, videos, and the Sunshine page stay free for everyone, always. If you would like to help keep them that way, a gift through any of the methods above — marked 'gift' — goes directly toward that.
